messages:
Maya (PM): quick sync: we need a minimal, customer-friendly pin + deprecation contract for pilots. no surprise swaps.
Oliver (Eng): summary of constraints: customers can pin a model version; pin TTL; a PENDING_DEPRECATION mode that blocks auto-roll and surfaces a flag.
Priya (SRE): ops ask: we need a clear rollback playbook that SRE can run without app changes. means routing control + health checks + canary window.
Jess (DevEx): API surface idea: include `lifecycle_state` and `deprecation_notice` in model metadata. machine-readable, plus human message for emails/console.
Sam (CS): customer side: they want an opt-in for automatic rollback on regression and a recorded audit trail for legal. also notice windows (30 / 14 / 7 days) configurable.
Oliver (Eng): runtime sketch: states = {ACTIVE, PINNED, PENDING_DEPRECATION, DEPRECATED}. pin object: {pin_version, pin_ttl_days, rollback_window_hours}. rollback flow: route -> 10% canary for 20m -> check telemetry -> ramp.
Maya (PM): launch gates proposal: (1) perf parity (latency within 5%), (2) quality check delta within threshold (customer metric or eval harness), (3) dry-run migration completed for pilot tenant.
Priya (SRE): telemetry needs: latency P50/P95, error rate, top-level quality signal (from evals/telemetry), and an automated alert that recommends rollback. SRE should be able to trigger immediate traffic switch.
Jess (DevEx): we'll add `lifecycle_state` to /models and include sample `curl` responses in docs. console will show a tenant-scoped banner when lifecycle != ACTIVE.
Maya (PM): policy decision: platform-initiated rollback only if tenant opted in, otherwise recommend manual. customers can always trigger immediate rollback via API.
Sam (CS): I'll document opt-in wording and add it to pilot onboarding. need a signed acknowledgement for enterprise customers.
Oliver (Eng): tasks & owners: API + metadata (Jess), routing + canary orchestration (Oliver + Priya), telemetry detectors (Priya), runbook + pilot coordination (Sam). estimate: 3 sprints to gated beta if parallelized.
release-bot: Created canary for catalog/redwood-chat-1.4 on pool-dedicated-12.
Maya (PM): next steps: Jess to draft API samples by Wed, Oliver to PR runtime changes by Thu, Priya to define alert thresholds & SRE playbook by Thu, Sam to confirm two pilot tenants by tomorrow. follow-up sync Friday.
Jess (DevEx): ack, will include `deprecation_notice` schema and example responses.
Priya (SRE): ack, will prepare runbook steps and rollback run commands.
Oliver (Eng): ack, will include rollback API and canary orchestration doc.
Maya (PM): great. call out blockers early. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
